title: Manali & Shimla: A First-Timer's Guide to Himachal Pradesh
subtitle: Himachal Pradesh is North India’s quintessential mountain playground, from snow adventures in Solang to the spiritual sanctuary of Dharamshala.

contentSections.heading: Manali & Shimla: A First-Timer's Guide to Himachal Pradesh
contentSections.content: Himachal Pradesh is North India’s quintessential mountain playground, from snow adventures in Solang to the spiritual sanctuary of Dharamshala.

contentSections.heading: Must-See Spots
contentSections.content: Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel lead into glacial waterfalls and thrilling all-season adventure sports. Shimla’s Ridge and Jakhoo Temple offer grand colonial vistas and a historic neo-Gothic Christ Church.

contentSections.heading: Travel Tips
bulletPoints: Rohtang Pass permits must be booked in advance as daily vehicle quotas are strictly limited.
Carry motion-sickness medication if you are prone to dizziness on winding mountain roads.
